scene: You arrive at breezy Observatory Hill.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view. On the far left sits the yellow funicular railway car at its platform. An astronomer snoozes at a wooden table with rolled star charts to the left. The elderly East Asian player stands centre with his cane. Up high points a large brass telescope, beside a copper dome on the far right.
shown: a large brass telescope on a tripod pointing up high
a dozing astronomer slumped over open star charts on the left
a round copper dome with an open doorway on the far right
